content: Timefold DefaultLocalSearchPhaseFactory: if <localSearch> has no moveSelector config at all, it auto-builds unionMoveSelector(ChangeMoveSelectorConfig, SwapMoveSelectorConfig) for basic non-chained variables. The moment ANY moveSelector is declared explicitly (e.g. to add a custom moveListFactory), this default auto-config is bypassed entirely — changeMoveSelector/swapMoveSelector must be listed explicitly inside your own unionMoveSelector or they silently disappear.
